item.title: Ask HN: Do people with authism have emotions?
item.summary: I discussed this topic with a workmate. He said autism people dont have emotions, they dont feel anything. I disagreed with him. What do you guys think? Are there any related researches related to this topic? Thanks for answering. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49239422 Points: 1 # Comments: 4
